purpose: Outcome-blind comparison of kEFi-selected PumpSwap buys against comparable non-selected candidate buys.
selected_sample: The sealed 1656 kEFi entry rows in enriched-v1.jsonl.
candidate_universe: PumpSwap BUY events from the same closed source partitions, with complete canonical event fields and no selected-wallet admission identity.
exclusions: Events without canonical pool, mint, slot, timestamp, reserve, and fee fields.
matching_rule: No predictive threshold is selected in this contract. Controls are stratified descriptively by source partition, mint/pool, and entry-time context where available.
labels: No economic outcome labels are used to define the comparison cohort.
horizon: 120 seconds after each candidate entry, requiring complete replay evidence or explicit exclusion.
selection_rule: Selected versus non-selected status is fixed by the wallet admission record, never inferred from replay performance.
holdout: None accessed; this is an isolated kEFi research sibling.
